entities.name: Heinrich August Jäschke
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Heinrich August Jäschke was a German Tibetologist missionary and Bible translator. From 1857 to 1868 he was missionary of the Herrnhuter Brüdergemeine in Kyelang, Lahaul District and Spiti in North India.
